4	/* HTIF syscall-window client: the uncached SimControl mailbox protocol
5	 * shared by every andesim runtime payload (vplat today; vlinux next). The
6	 * window lives in DEVICE space (PMA-uncached on every engine), so the
7	 * exchange is coherent by construction on any cache hierarchy, including a
8	 * private write-back L2 (ax66 PL2C) that a cacheable-RAM mailbox cannot
9	 * survive: the guest would read its own stale copy of the host's result,
10	 * and no guest-side CCTL sequence can fix that (the VA-scoped forms trap
11	 * on RVH cores, the ALL forms drop unrelated dirty lines).
12	 *
13	 *   stdio (fd 0-2)  ATCUART100 UART2: THR @0xf0300020, LSR @0xf0300034.
14	 *   file io (fd>2)  the SimControl syscall WINDOW @0xe0080800: eight u64
15	 *                   arg/result slots + a data area for payloads, doorbell
16	 *                   @0xe0080028. Served host-side (vsim: sim_control.hpp
17	 *                   dispatch_window; QEMU: andes_ae350.c's mirror).
18	 *
19	 * No semihosting, no ecall, and no "which engine am I on" probe -- hybrid
20	 * migrates the running process between engines, so any boot-time detection
21	 * would go stale at the handoff. Every call must be engine-blind.
22	 */

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# run trigger/pc gating: --trigger / --pc-start / --pc-end are the hybrid ROI
# delimiters. fast/cycle used to silently IGNORE them -- a user asking for a
# pc window got a whole-program cycle figure with no warning. They are now
# rejected (rc 2) on any model except hybrid.
#
#   1. cycle/fast + --trigger          -> usage error (rc 2)
#   2. cycle/fast + --pc-end           -> usage error (rc 2)
#   3. cycle/fast + --pc-start         -> usage error (rc 2)
#   5. hybrid + --trigger pc + pc-*    -> never gated (reaches the ELF check)
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_hello}"
hybrid_resolve_paths
ENGINE="${ENGINE:-vsim:ax45mpv_premium}"
MISSING=/no/such/file.elf

# 1-3. fast/cycle reject the hybrid-only ROI knobs (real ELF: pre-gate these
# ran the whole program and returned 0; the gate must now turn them into rc 2).
expect 2 'trigger applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine "$ENGINE" --trigger pc \
  --pc-start 0x100074 --pc-end 0x100080 "$VSIM_ELF"

input.reason: Verified by direct read: _stat (runtime/vplat_syscalls.c:84-95) and _lstat (97-108) are byte-identical except VH_SYS_STAT vs VH_SYS_LSTAT; a static stat_path(nr, file, st) helper reproduces the exact htif_win_store_str/bound-check/htif_win_store/htif_syscall/htif_win_load sequence with only the syscall-number immediate parameterized, so the wire traffic is bit-identical. _fstatat (110-122) does repeat the shape but with shifted arg slots (dirfd in a0, path VA in a1, stat VA in a2, flags in a3), so the claim's "two leading args" sharing idea doesn't map cleanly - the claim's own "or be left as-is" fallback is the right call. The htif_call_str/htif_call_str2 precedent exists in htif_client.c:83-95. No external consumer breaks: the symbols are linker-resolved newlib stubs kept unchanged with __attribute__((used)); vsim's host side dispatches on syscall number only (sim_control.hpp slots 16/18/19); the one test with hardcoded PCs (test_andes_sim_trigger_gating.sh 0x100074/0x100080) expects rc 2 from arg gating before any ELF executes, so runtime code-size shifts are harmless. Pure extract-function, no observable behavior change.
